reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #18 ('No User Authentication System Implemented') is not a concrete, focused code change to this repository; it is an unbounded, hyperbolic/satirical authentication mega-feature dump whose central premise is also factually false. Requested work spans Google/Facebook/GitHub/Twitter OAuth, WebAuthn biometrics, a PostgreSQL+Redis+MongoDB hybrid credential store, AES-256 at rest, bcrypt with >=500,000 iterations, TOTP MFA + email verification + security questions, RBAC roles, TLS 1.3 + HSTS preload + SSL pinning, end-to-end PGP, hosting authentication logs on private blockchain nodes, WebSocket single-session enforcement, a CAPTCHA demanding a 500-word essay, dark-web monitoring against 10 billion leaked credentials, and a $100,000-per-vulnerability bug bounty with an ex-NSA red team plus biannual third-party audits. None of this is a reproducible defect, a specific scoped engineering feature, or focused code-level maintenance, and it cites no file, function or failing assertion. The premise 'There is no user login system / no JWT token-based authentication' is false: the repository already ships email/password auth with bcrypt hashing and JWT sessions. The quoted $100,000 'funding' is the satirical bug-bounty reward written inside the issue body itself (source_url is the issue), not live external funding. No open PRs, no competing branch, no comments. Per the delivery rules this must be written blocked with evidence and the checkout left unchanged.
